notes.title: Trading Cards are Available Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38310448/691c3389ecde549b8bb03228fe1b65e8462154cb.png[/img]

We're thrilled to announce that [b]Nine Witches: Family Disruption[/b] now has trading cards that you can collect as you play!

Steam Trading Cards are virtual cards earned by playing games on Steam. Once you’ve collected a set of cards, these can be turned into game badges and tradable Steam community items. All badges also have XP which contributes to your Steam Level.

Play the game now to collect them all!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272580/Nine_Witches_Family_Disruption/

notes.title: Nominate Nine Witches for the “Outstanding Story-Rich Game” Steam Award!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Professors!

Thank you for playing and supporting [b]Nine Witches: Family Disruption[/b]! We’re overwhelmed with the immense amount of love we’ve gotten for this game.

We're almost at the end of the year, and as usual, it's time for the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/nominations]Steam Awards[/url][/b]!

We'd really appreciate it if you would nominate Nine Witches for the [b]Outstanding Story-Rich Game[/b] category in the awards. Outstanding Story-Rich Game highlights narrative-heavy games, and we think that Nine Witches has a good balance of Extremely Accurate History and humour!

You can nominate the game in the Nine Witches Steam page, where you only have to click on the [b]Nominate this Game For the Steam Awards[/b] purple box and select the [b]Outstanding Story-Rich Game[/b] category.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1272580/Nine_Witches_Family_Disruption/

notes.title: Nine Witches wins 2 BIT BANG Fest awards!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38310448/71fe492c85cd166cba16f7d1291111e07b44b358.jpg[/img]

¡Vamos, Nine Witches! 🍾

We're proud to announce that [b]Nine Witches: Family Disruption[/b] won 2 awards at [b][url=https://www.bitbangfest.com/en/information/]BIT BANG Fest[/url][/b].

BIT BANG is the biggest animation, video games and digital arts festival held in the city of Buenos Aires, Argentina.

Nine Witches won in the Best Storytelling and Best Latinamerican Game categories 🎉

The entire list of games that were participating can be found [url=https://www.bitbangfest.com/en/international-independent-game-competition/]here[/url]. We're proud to stand alongside these amazing indie titles!
